intro: The Demon Scarred Cloak is a ragged pelt recovered from the legendary white wolf Ghost Howl, who roams the grassy plains of Mulgore. Marked by an enduring wound inflicted during past clashes with the Burning Legion, the pelt serves as proof of the beast's release from torment. Bringing it to the elders of Bloodhoof Village brings closure to the story of a tragic local legend.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the Burning Legion.
Perhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can barely believe my old eyes! You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl? I look upon you with new respect, young adventurer. You are a hunter of extreme skills!
Let me offer you something. My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.
May it strike true, and bring you renown.
And let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.
